stories.headline: Indian Shares Surge On FII Flows
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Indian shares were notably higher on Monday as falling oil prices helped ease concerns over inflation and India's import bill.

stories.headline: Amex Projects 14-Year High for Small Business Holiday Spend
stories.body: American Express is projecting that 88% of American consumers will patronize a small business during this year’s holiday season. stories.headline: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker
stories.body: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.
